variant_decisions.evidence: Qere reads plural חֳמַרְמְרוּ, ketiv singular חמרמרה; both agree with פָּנַי (plural form, singular sense). ASV 'My face is red' renders the English singular noun 'face' with a singular verb regardless of Hebrew number, and no textual note is mapped to this unit, so the English does not distinguish the readings. Base qere fallback retained.
